sources.quote:
I get wanting to support as many languages as possible, but using AI is not the way, guys. The translations will be utterly useless and miss key context of the original text, it's also downright insulting to people who need those languages, if you can't afford to hire translators who will do a good job then don't bother.
r_Sh4d0w View Profile View Posts 2 1 1 Oct 27 @ 2:24pm Report this post have you tried to volunteer as a free translator? #1
Cadence Squirrel View Profile View Posts Oct 27 @ 2:37pm Report this post Originally posted by r_Sh4d0w : have you tried to volunteer as a free translator? I would if I could. Best I could help with would be script writing. #2
fearthesloth View Profile View Posts 2 Oct 27 @ 2:47pm Report this post Originally posted by Cadence Squirrel : Originally posted by r_Sh4d0w : have you tried to volunteer as a free translator? I would if I could. Best I could help with would be script writing. Why can't you volunteer? You're the one with an issue about a small dev team of just two people using AI to assist them, which I think is a bit rubbish of you. So if you have such a big issue about this, why can't you pitch in and help them with the translation? #3
Cadence Squirrel View Profile View Posts Oct 27 @ 2:54pm Report this post Originally posted by fearthesloth : Originally posted by Cadence Squirrel : I would if I could. Best I could help with would be script writing. Why can't you volunteer? You're the one with an issue about a small dev team of just two people using AI to assist them, which I think is a bit rubbish of you. So if you have such a big issue about this, why can't you pitch in and help them with the translation? Being a small team is no excuse for being lazy and half-assing things like localisations which some people need to even play the game. If you actually put the effort into finding people you can find real talented translators who will volunteer or work cheaply, using AI is just lazy and is an insult to the people who genuinely need translations, we don't put up with ♥♥♥♥♥♥ dubs, why should we put up with lazy AI translations in a paid game? #4
Nedrith View Profile View Posts 1 Oct 27 @ 2:58pm Report this post Thankfully you don't speak for everyone. If I had the choice between playing a game using AI translations, which will 99% of the time be good enough to play the game with, or not playing the game at all or atleast not understand the words at all, I'd rather play a good game that might not be perfectly translated. Can't exactly rely on volunteer translators, which take a lot of work to manage them, and those people who need translations? There aren't enough of them to justify hiring a translator. #5
Cadence Squirrel View Profile View Posts Oct 27 @ 2:59pm Report this post Originally posted by Nedrith : Thankfully you don't speak for everyone. If I had the choice between playing a game using AI translations, which will 99% of the time be good enough to play the game with, or not playing the game at all or atleast not understand the words at all, I'd rather play a good game that might not be perfectly translated. Can't exactly rely on volunteer translators, which take a lot of work to manage them, and those people who need translations? There aren't enough of them to justify hiring a translator. It must be nice having low standards. #6
fearthesloth View Profile View Posts Oct 27 @ 3:03pm Report this post I disagree. I think being a small team of just two people is absolutely fine, and makes using productivity tools like AI a no brainer. I also don't agree that makes the devs "lazy". But judging by the aggressive and judgmental language you use, you clearly have a strong issue about this, and frankly you're just coming off as a troll and a grumpy little boy. So be angry with the devs for a wonky and short-sighted reason, but you just like look like a fool. #7
Sam K View Profile View Posts Oct 27 @ 3:10pm Report this post oohhhh no AI cry cry cry cry cry cry cry cry cry cry cry cry #8
JoshG View Profile View Posts 2 Oct 27 @ 3:38pm Report this post People just constantly want to cry about AI now. It's getting old. It's here, it's not going away. It is what it is. Translating is like the most mild, practical, inoffensive form of it. You're going to have trouble adapting if this upsets you. #9
Archernar View Profile View Posts Oct 27 @ 3:40pm Report this post I agree, using AI for translation is really stupid. And for the AI stans out there, the actual problem with using AI translation is that it's less refined and uses far more physical resources than the computer-assisted translation tools we already have, and have used for decades. AI translators have been systemically overpromising what they can deliver vs using traditional CAT with it's multiple decades worth of translation memories and glossaries and centuries of references. They are shoe-horning themselves into a field that they are not only not ready for, but actively stealing source reference from. That's it. #10
Electron View Profile View Posts Oct 27 @ 3:41pm Report this post AI will do a much better job of translation than any human. Its the ideal task for AI. #11
